TC1.Hidden_Test_Description: Check GPIO register default values and masked write/read across configured address list using addr_array, read_mask_array, write_mask_array, and default_value_array; count failures and finish(0/1).
TC1.Hidden_Remarks:
//80,94,98,9c,a0,a4,a8,ac,b0...SKIPPING VRRW registers
//when reading default values the din value is becoming 1 automatically if we don't force any value,but if we force zero to din bit level sel becoming high,so that reding value not matched with expected value
TC1.Hidden_Validation_Acceptance_Criteria: Default check: (data_rd & 0xfffffffe) == default_value_array[i] for all i where read_mask_array[i]!=0 and skip_rst_array[i]==0. Write/read check for each pattern: data_rd == (((data_wr & read_mask_array[i] & write_mask_array[i]) | ((write_mask_array[i]^0xffffffff) & read_mask_array[i] & default_value_array[i]))) for all i where read and write enabled and skip_array[i]==0. PASS if def_fail_cnt==0 and wr_fail_cnt==0; else FAIL.

TC2.Hidden_Test_Description: Enable GPIO instance interrupt, configure GP0_GPIO_8..39 with doe=1, neie=1, iclr=1, then for each bit enable group interrupt, create a falling edge via 0xA0243ffc, wait with timeout, and validate DIN low, group status asserted and cleared, and sysreg raw cleared in Default_IRQHandler; accumulate test_err and finish(test_err).
TC2.Hidden_Test_Steps_Procedure:
1) Entry: int test_case() initializes test_err=0. Optionally GIC_EnableIRQ(87/88) per GPIO0/GPIO1.
2) Enable sysreg interrupt: write_reg(MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_INTR_EN1, LSS_SYSREG_INTR_EN1_GPIO0_INTR or LSS_SYSREG_INTR_EN1_GPIO1_INTR).
3) write_reg(0xA0243ffc, 0xffffffff) to drive all pads high.
4) For (i=0;i<32;i++): addr1=MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_8+(i*4); write_reg(addr1, (1u<<20)|(1u<<18)|(1u<<16)); wait_on(10).  // doe=1, neie=1, iclr=1
5) For (i=0;i<32;i++): wr_val=1u<<i; write_reg(MIZAR_GPIO_GPIO_INTR_RAW_STCLR1, wr_val); write_reg(MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_EN1, wr_val); wait_on(10); int_pend=1; write_reg(0xA0243ffc, 0xffffffff); wait_on(30); write_reg(0xA0243ffc, ~wr_val); unsigned int timeout=5000; while (int_pend && timeout--) { wait_on(10); } if (timeout==0) { printf("ERROR: Timeout waiting for GPIO%u negedge interrupt\n",(unsigned)(i+8)); test_err++; }
6) finish(test_err).
7) ISR: void Default_IRQHandler(): local_wr=1u<<i; int_pend=0; write_reg(0xA0243ffc,0xffffffff); raddr=MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_8+(i*4); rdata=read_reg(raddr); if ((rdata & 0x1) != 0) { test_err++; } if ((rdata & 0x2) != 0x0) { rdata_grp=read_reg(MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_STS1); if ((rdata_grp & local_wr) == 0) { test_err++; } raddr2=MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_8+(i*4); write_reg(raddr2, (1u<<20)|(1u<<16)); write_reg(MIZAR_GPIO_GPIO_INTR_RAW_STCLR1, local_wr); rdata_grp=read_reg(MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_STS1); if (rdata_grp != 0x0) { test_err++; } #ifdef GPIO0 write_reg(MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_RAW_STCR1, LSS_SYSREG_RAW_STCR1_GPIO0_INTR); GIC_ClearIRQ(87); #endif #ifdef GPIO1 write_reg(MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_RAW_STCR1, LSS_SYSREG_RAW_STCR1_GPIO1_INTR); GIC_ClearIRQ(88); #endif } else { test_err++; }
TC2.Hidden_Validation_Acceptance_Criteria: Timeout check: if bounded wait expires, increment test_err. In ISR: (rdata & 0x1) must be 0 (DIN low). Group check: (read_reg(MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_STS1) & (1u<<i)) must be nonzero on entry and become 0 after clearing via per-pin iclr write and MIZAR_GPIO_GPIO_INTR_RAW_STCLR1 write. System raw clear: after write to MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_RAW_STCR1 with instance-specific bit, a readback (if performed) shows cleared; GIC IRQ cleared. PASS if test_err remains 0 across all pins; otherwise FAIL.

TC3.Hidden_Test_Description: Enable GPIO instance interrupt, configure GP0_GPIO_8..39 with peie=1, place pads in input mode via group IO control, enable all per-pin interrupts, then for each pin generate a rising edge via 0xA0243ffc, wait with timeout, and in Default_IRQHandler verify group status nonzero, clear per-pin raw for all pins, verify group clear, clear sysreg raw with readback, re-enable group, and finish(test_err).
TC3.Hidden_Test_Steps_Procedure:
1) Entry: void test_case() optionally GIC_EnableIRQ(87/88).
2) Enable sysreg interrupt output: write_reg(MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_INTR_EN1, LSS_SYSREG_INTR_EN1_GPIO0_INTR or LSS_SYSREG_INTR_EN1_GPIO1_INTR).
3) For (i=0;i<32;i++): write_reg(MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_8 + (i*4), 0x00020000); // peie=1
4) wait_on(10);
5) Set input mode for pads 8–39: write_reg(MIZAR_GPIO_GPIO_IO_CTRL_GROUP1, 0x000000FF); similarly GROUP2..GROUP4; wait_on(10).
6) Enable all per-pin interrupts: write_reg(MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_EN1, 0xFFFFFFFF).
7) For (i=0;i<32;i++): write_reg(0xA0243ffc, 0x00000000); wait_on(10); int_pend=1; write_reg(0xA0243ffc, 0xFFFFFFFF); int timeout=2000; while ((int_pend==1) && (--timeout>0)) { wait_on(10); } if (timeout==0) { printf("ERROR: Timeout waiting for GPIO IRQ at i=%u\n", i); test_err++; break; } write_reg(0xA0243ffc, 0x00000000); wait_on(10).
8) finish(test_err).
9) ISR: void Default_IRQHandler(): wr_val=1<<i; int_pend=0; rdata_grp=read_reg(MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_STS1); write_reg(MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_EN1, 0x00000000); if ((rdata_grp & 0xffffffff) == 0) { printf("ERROR: Group Interrupt not occured\n"); test_err++; } for (j=0;j<32;j++){ write_reg(MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_8 + (j*4), 0x00010000); } wait_on(2); rdata_grp=read_reg(MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_STS1); if (rdata_grp != 0x0) { printf("ERROR : Group Interrupt clear failed: Interrupt value:%x\n", rdata_grp); test_err++; } #ifdef GPIO0 write_reg(MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_RAW_STCR1, LSS_SYSREG_RAW_STCR1_GPIO0_INTR); rdata=read_reg(MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_RAW_STCR1); if ((rdata & LSS_SYSREG_RAW_STCR1_GPIO0_INTR) != 0) { printf("sysreg status not cleared : %0x\n", MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_RAW_STCR1); test_err++; } #endif #ifdef GPIO1 write_reg(MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_RAW_STCR1, LSS_SYSREG_RAW_STCR1_GPIO1_INTR); rdata=read_reg(MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_RAW_STCR1); if ((rdata & LSS_SYSREG_RAW_STCR1_GPIO1_INTR) != 0) { printf("sysreg status not cleared : %0x\n", MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_RAW_STCR1); test_err++; } #endif write_reg(MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_EN1, 0xFFFFFFFF); GIC_ClearIRQ(87/88).
TC3.Hidden_Validation_Acceptance_Criteria: Timeout: if bounded wait expires for any pin, increment test_err and stop iterations. In ISR: read of MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_STS1 must be nonzero on entry; after clearing per-pin raw across all pins and waiting, it must read 0x0. System raw clear: after write to MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_RAW_STCR1, a readback must show the instance bit cleared. PASS if no timeouts and all checks hold; otherwise FAIL.
